justification: Lowers two published coverage counts to the live values after held rules were rolled back

break_it.scenario: published count higher than the rules actually served
break_it.what_happens: the site claims coverage for councils it does not serve
break_it.how: values set from verify_coverage_stats live column

break_it.scenario: council_quote run from /app in the Railway image
break_it.what_happens: ROOT.parents[2] raised IndexError and dcp-commit exited 1

break_it.scenario: pinned test or figure ledger still names the old count
break_it.what_happens: CI fails on the honest lower number
break_it.how: ledger and pinned test moved to 22 and 12 together

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a published coverage count in coverage.ts differs from the live database count
falsifiable_check.observed_red: before the change: DRIFT DETECTED dcpNumericCouncils published 24 vs live 22, dcpSetbackTripleCouncils published 13 vs live 12

pre_impl.existing_data: coverage.ts published counts, checked by verify_coverage_stats against the live tables
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: council_quote assumed the repo always sits three folders below a parent, but the Railway image is /app
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: edits existing values, the existing ledger, the existing pinned test and one existing function call; adds one helper

functions.name: _env_file
functions.input: the repository root folder path object
functions.output: path of the .env file to load
functions.if_none: a root with fewer than three parents returns root/.env instead of raising IndexError
